bimcoLatest.report: Dry Bulk Shipping Market Overview & Outlook — October 2026
bimcoLatest.access: Full October PDF requires membership. Supply/demand scenarios come from the BIMCO statement republished by Cyprus Shipping News; delivery DWT comes from FBJNA and Marine & Industrial Report citing BIMCO. Annual October recycling DWT is unverified. The recycling card separately uses the verified January 2026 original PDF, clearly labeled as an older forecast.

closed.label: 荷姆茲持續受阻
closed.assumption: 2027、2028 年荷姆茲海峽持續實質關閉。

open.label: 2027 年起恢復通行
open.assumption: 2027 年起船舶可自由通過荷姆茲海峽。2027 年需求、供給增速依原文各增加 1 個百分點換算；2028 年與受阻情境相同。

bimcoLatest.balance: BIMCO expects the dry bulk supply/demand balance to weaken gradually in 2027 and 2028, from a high baseline.

deliveryEvidence.note: Both public articles report 51.7 million DWT in 2027 and 54.1 million DWT in 2028; original October PDF table not verified.

recyclingEvidence.outlook: Ship recycling is expected to increase, while rising deliveries continue to support strong fleet growth.
recyclingEvidence.annualDWTStatus: Not located in the verified free summaries and media reports; no claim that the full report lacks the figures.

bimcoRecycling.report: Dry Bulk Shipping Market Overview & Outlook — January 2026
bimcoRecycling.selectionReason: Most recent BIMCO original report with annual dry bulk recycling DWT verified in this research. Older forecast; not the October 2026 forecast.
bimcoRecycling.coverageNote: January report forecasts 2026 and 2027; only future calendar year 2027 is displayed. No 2028 recycling figure inferred.
bimcoRecycling.comparisonNote: Do not subtract January recycling from October deliveries and label it a current BIMCO net-capacity forecast.
